description: End-to-end lifecycle for defining, monitoring, enforcing, and remediating network SLAs in a Telecom-as-a-Service (TaaS) network intelligence platform.

sla_id.description: Unique identifier for an SLA definition.

sla_version_id.description: Unique identifier for a specific version of an SLA.

policy_id.description: Identifier of a network policy linked to an SLA.

violation_id.description: Identifier for an SLA violation incident.

remediation_run_id.description: Identifier for an automated remediation execution.

network_scope.description: Common scoping object for where an SLA applies in the network.

scope_type.description: Type of network scope to which the SLA applies.

identifiers.description: Identifiers for the selected scope type.

kpi_definition.description: Reusable KPI definition for SLA targets.

metric_id.description: Internal metric identifier in the telemetry platform.

threshold.description: Target or limit value depending on comparator.

evaluation_window.description: Time window for evaluating KPI compliance.

rolling.description: Whether evaluation uses rolling window or fixed intervals.

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: define_sla_template
functions.description: Create a new SLA template with KPIs, network scope, and evaluation rules.

name.description: Human-readable name of the SLA template.

description.description: Detailed description of the SLA intent.

kpis.description: List of KPI definitions that form the SLA.

applicability.description: Conditions under which this SLA is applied.

min_bandwidth_mbps.description: Minimum bandwidth threshold for SLA applicability.

breach_policies.description: What to do when SLA is breached.

severity_mapping.description: Map KPI deviation ranges to severity levels.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for tagging and integration.

functions.returns: New SLA template created with sla_id and initial version information.

functions.name: update_sla_template
functions.description: Update an existing SLA template and create a new version with change tracking.

sla_id.description: Identifier of the SLA to update.

base_version_id.description: Version being updated, used for optimistic concurrency control.

change_reason.description: Reason for change to be recorded in the audit log.

functions.returns: Updated SLA template with new sla_version_id and diff summary.

functions.name: list_slas
functions.description: List existing SLAs with filtering, pagination, and version selection.

tag.description: Filter by a metadata tag value.

search.description: Free-text search across SLA name and description.

include_latest_only.description: If true, only return the latest version per SLA.

functions.returns: Paginated list of SLAs with basic details, current status, and version information.

functions.name: get_sla_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details of an SLA, including versions, KPIs, and policies.

sla_version_id.description: Optional version identifier; if omitted, latest active version is returned.

functions.returns: Complete SLA definition, version history (optional), and any requested related information.

functions.name: activate_sla
functions.description: Activate or schedule an SLA version for enforcement in the network.

sla_version_id.description: Version to activate; if omitted, latest version is used.

activation_mode.description: How the SLA should be rolled out.

schedule.description: Scheduling details if activation_mode is scheduled or canary.

percentage.description: Percentage of scope to include in canary.

max_blast_radius.description: Maximum number of entities affected in canary.

conflict_handling.description: How to handle conflicts with existing active SLAs.

dry_run.description: If true, only validate activation without applying.

functions.returns: Activation status, any conflicts detected, and effective policy summary for the applied scope.

functions.name: check_sla_compliance
functions.description: Evaluate current and historical SLA compliance across the network scope.

group_by.description: Dimensions over which to aggregate compliance.

functions.returns: Compliance score, per-KPI results, aggregated statistics, and requested breakdowns for the time range.

functions.name: list_sla_violations
functions.description: List SLA violations with filters, including open and historical incidents.

scope_id.description: Specific entity id within the chosen scope_type.

functions.returns: Paginated list of SLA violations with severity, status, affected scope, and high-level impact metrics.

functions.name: get_violation_details
functions.description: Get full details of a specific SLA violation, including contributing factors and impact analysis.
functions.returns: Detailed violation object, including metrics, affected entities, probable root cause, and any associated actions.

functions.name: trigger_remediation
functions.description: Trigger or schedule an automated remediation workflow for an SLA violation or at-risk condition.

remediation_context.description: Context in which remediation is triggered.

sla_id.description: Used for proactive or manual scope remediation.

playbook_id.description: Identifier for a predefined remediation playbook.

steps_override.description: Custom steps overriding a default playbook.

rollback_step.description: Definition of how to rollback this step.

safe_mode.description: If true, only non-disruptive actions are permitted.

dry_run.description: If true, simulate remediation without making changes.

functions.returns: Remediation run created with remediation_run_id, initial status, and step plan summary.

functions.name: rollback_remediation
functions.description: Rollback changes made by a previous remediation run, partially or fully.

target_step_index.description: Step index to roll back to when rollback_mode is to_step.

step_subset.description: List of step IDs or indices to rollback when mode is custom_subset.

force.description: If true, attempt rollback even if some step metadata is missing.

functions.returns: Rollback execution summary, updated remediation run status, and any residual drift information.

functions.name: get_remediation_status
functions.description: Get status, logs, and outcomes of a remediation run, including failed steps for retry.
functions.returns: Remediation run state, per-step status, logs, and optional impact metrics.

functions.name: retry_sla_enforcement
functions.description: Retry SLA enforcement or policy deployment after a failure or partial success.

previous_activation_id.description: Identifier of the previous activation attempt to reference failed entities.

custom_entities.description: Explicit list of entities to retry when retry_scope is custom.

skip_validation.description: If true, skip pre-deployment validation checks.

functions.returns: Retry job identifier, targeted entities, and initial retry deployment status.

functions.name: suppress_sla_violation
functions.description: Temporarily or permanently suppress alerting and remediation for a specific SLA violation or scope.

sla_id.description: Required when suppress_mode is by_sla or for scope-specific suppression tied to an SLA.

duration.description: How long the suppression remains active.

reason.description: Business or operational reason for suppression.

functions.returns: Suppression rule identifier, effective scope, and expiration details.

functions.name: sla_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import sla entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: sla_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many sla entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: sla_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many sla entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: sla_bulk_export
functions.description: Export sla entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: sla_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across sla entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: sla_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for sla events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: sla_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for sla notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: sla_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more sla entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: sla_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to sla on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: sla_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a sla operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: sla_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending sla change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: sla_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending sla approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: sla_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a sla entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: sla_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a sla entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: sla_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a sla entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: sla_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a sla entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: sla_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for sla activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: sla_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a sla view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: sla_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to sla entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: sla_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given sla payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: sla_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a sla entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: sla_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a sla entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
